Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. The RN will assess patient and family needs, develop and implement individualized care plans, administer prescribed medications and treatments, educate patients and caregivers, and coordinate care with physicians and other healthcare professionals.

The successful candidate will demonstrate strong clinical judgment, excellent communication and problem-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. This role also involves discharge planning, case management when assigned, and supervising and evaluating home health aide services to support safe, coordinated, and effective patient care.

If you are passionate about helping patients maintain their independence and well-being at home, we encourage you to join our team.

Note: This is a field-based, per diem position that requires travel to patientsâ homes. Although listed as âremote,â this is not a work-from-home or telehealth role.

Responsibilities
    • Conduct initial patient and family assessments to determine home health care needs, including physical assessments and histories of current and previous illnesses.
    • Regularly reassess patientsâ nursing needs and evaluate changes in their conditions.
    • Initiate and revise individualized plans of care as patient status and needs change.
    • Use assessment findings to establish nursing diagnoses and develop appropriate care plans.
    • Develop care plans that establish patient-centered goals and incorporate therapeutic, preventive, and rehabilitative nursing interventions.
    • Involve patients and their families in care planning and decision-making.
    • Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by the physician.
    • Implement appropriate preventive and rehabilitative nursing procedures.
    • Counsel patients and families regarding nursing and related healthcare needs.
    • Provide patient and caregiver education based on assessments and the established plan of care.
    • Identify discharge planning needs during care planning and implement appropriate arrangements before patient discharge.
    • Serve as case manager when assigned by the Clinical Supervisor or Nursing Supervisor, coordinating care for the assigned patient caseload.
    • Prepare accurate clinical notes and update the primary physician as needed and at least every 60 days.
    • Communicate patient needs and changes in condition to physicians, and obtain or receive physician orders as required.
    • Coordinate with community healthcare professionals and other relevant parties to support the patient's plan of care.
    • Participate in on-call duties according to organizational policy.
    • Ensure arrangements for necessary equipment, supplies, and other patient services.
    • Instruct, supervise, and evaluate home health aide services provided to patients every two weeks.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned to support patient care.
    • Graduate of an accredited school of nursing.
    • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) license in California.
    • At least 1â2 years of recent acute care experience in an institutional setting.
    • Current CPR certification.
    • Valid driver's license and access to a reliable vehicle insured in accordance with state and organizational requirements.
    • Excellent observation and clinical assessment skills.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
    • Effective problem-solving skills and basic mathematical skills.
    • Ability to perform nursing duties according to established competency requirements.
    • Ability to work independently and coordinate patient care responsibilities.
    • Ability to perform the physical duties associated with patient care, including prolonged standing or walking, lifting supplies and equipment, and assisting with patient positioning or transfers, with applicable accommodations.

    • Bachelor's degree in nursing.

title: Web Designer at AIOS — Remote, $100k-$200k/yr (including equity)
description:
About AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

You’ll design landing pages, funnels, quizzes and onboarding flows across Bolt Pharmacy, Bolt Med and the new markets we’re launching. You’ll lean on AI to design, build and test at a pace a traditional team can’t match.

This is a full-time, fully remote role, and you’ll work mostly async in the timezone of your choice, as long as you’re around until midday Pacific Time every weekday.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll report directly to Ryan Wu, our Head of Design. You’ll work closely with Michael McCann, our CRO Lead.

You’ll sit within the Growth team, which is currently led by our CEO (Richie). I (Richie) intense, so you’ll also be intense. You’ll work long days and regularly work weekends.

This is an awful job for the vast majority of people looking for a job. Stay away! And for the right person, this will be the best role of your life :)

Key responsibilities

You’ll own web conversion end to end, from insight through to live page. This role exists to turn growth bets into high-converting pages, fast.

  • Strategic ownership: Own the outcome, not the artefact. Spot what’s holding conversion back, form a point of view, make the case and see it through. We want you shaping what we build, not just how it looks.

  • High-converting web design: Design websites, landing pages, funnels and onboarding flows that get people to act. Clear hierarchy, sharp copy flow and a strong offer beat decoration every time.

  • Value propositions: Turn what we know about our patients into compelling USPs and value propositions, then test which ones land.

  • Follow the scent: Take the scent trails you’re given (data, research, CRO insights, a hunch from the founders) and turn them into high-converting designs, with a high degree of autonomy.

  • Figma to live: Get your designs out of Figma and into frontend code yourself. We currently use Webflow. No handoff queue, no waiting on a developer.

  • AI-powered design and build: Use AI to design, build and generate A/B tests and landing pages. Prompt your way to high-quality work rather than doing it all by hand.

  • Systems that scale: Build and improve the AI workflows, components and templates that let one designer do the work of a whole team, while keeping brand quality high.

  • Ship fast: Go from idea to live test in days, not weeks. Read the results, cut what doesn’t work and double down on what does.

Need to have

  • Experience: 3+ years designing high-performing websites and landing pages, with a portfolio that shows results, not just visuals.

  • User psychology: A strong understanding of what motivates people to convert, and how hierarchy, copy, proof and friction shape a decision.

  • Value propositions: Able to craft compelling USPs and value propositions, and put them on a page so they land.

  • Design to code: Comfortable moving your own designs into frontend code. Webflow experience is helpful but not essential.

  • AI-native: At the forefront of AI in design. You already use it in your day-to-day workflow, you’re strong at building AI systems that scale your output, and you’re keen to push adoption further.

  • Ownership: Self-directed and happy to own work from insight through to live page. You don’t wait for direction, you find what’s missing and fix it.

  • Speed: You ship fast without dropping quality. You’d rather get something live and learn than polish it in Figma for another week.

  • Craft: High standards for polish, spacing, responsiveness and load speed.

Nice to have

  • CRO: Experience running or designing for A/B and multivariate tests.

  • Analytics: Comfortable reading performance data and using behaviour tools to decide what to try next.

  • Product flows: Experience with onboarding, checkout or other key conversion touchpoints.

  • Regulated markets: Experience designing for healthcare, pharmacy or other regulated industries.

  • Design Systems : Experience building or maintaining component-based systems for testing and scale.

  • Multi-market: Experience adapting pages for different countries and languages.

  • SEO and performance: Understanding of how design choices affect SEO and page speed.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come, it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully, in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status. We ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.


🎯"You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

You get paid above market salary and you get early stage equity, so you get really rich if we nail this.

  • Compensation: $100k-$200k/yr including equity

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Healthcare: comprehensive medical insurance (if appropriate).

  • Remote: our team is fully distributed across the world and functions fully remotely.

  • Personal development: budget for books, courses, coaching.

  • Personal wellness: budget for gym, health apps.

  • GLP-1s: free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s.

  • Health coaching: free biweekly health coaching so you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: free biweekly work coaching so you stay sharp + calm.

  • Equipment: Macbook & work-from-home equipment provided as needed.

  • What are we missing? We're still early so you get to shape our culture.

How to apply

Apply via Ashby and be sure to include:

  • your resume and portfolio

  • 2 or 3 live pages you designed and shipped, and what happened to conversion

title: Co-Founder & COO (m/w/d) gesucht für Corporate Philanthropy Plattform | Düsseldorf/Remote
description:
Über Bonoboo


Bei Bonoboo bauen wir die Plattform für Corporate Philanthropy. Mit KI-gestütztem Matchmaking verbinden wir Unternehmen gezielt mit passenden gemeinnützigen Organisationen. Das Ziel: messbare Wirkung, effizientere Spendenprozesse und datenbasiertes gesellschaftliches Engagement. Wir sind ein wachsendes, internationales Team mit Hauptsitz in Düsseldorf und wollen die Spendenbranche nachhaltig verändern.

Wo wir stehen
Unser Produkt ist validiert, und erste Unternehmen setzen Bonoboo bereits zahlend ein. Wir sind mitten in der Pre-Seed-Phase, mehrere Business Angels sind an Bord, und das Kapital für die nächsten Schritte ist gesichert. Jetzt geht es darum, aus einem funktionierenden Produkt ein skalierendes Unternehmen zu machen. Dafür suchen wir dich.

Wer wir sind

  • Julia, CEO & Founder: bringt Expertise in Sales und Finance mit und verantwortet Vertrieb, Finanzen und Fundraising.

  • Max, CTO & Co-Founder: hat Erfahrung als KI-Entwickler und verantwortet Produkt und Tech.

Was uns noch fehlt, ist die Person, die den Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo nicht nur mitdenkt, sondern operativ führt und nach außen trägt.

Deine Aufgaben als Co-Founder & COO

Du verantwortest den gesamten Impact-Bereich von Bonoboo und gestaltest den Aufbau unseres Start-ups maßgeblich mit.

Strategie & Impact
Du denkst mit uns die großen Fragen: Wie skaliert Corporate Philanthropy? Wo hebeln wir Wirkung am stärksten? Du bringst strategische Klarheit in ein Feld, das oft unscharf bleibt.

Operative Leitung Impact
Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für alles, was mit Impact zu tun hat, von Prozessen bis zur Reporting-Logik. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus Vision gelebte Praxis wird.

NGO-Partnernetzwerk & Success Management
Du baust unser Netzwerk an NGO-Partner:innen auf und pflegst es. Du verstehst ihre Bedürfnisse und sorgst dafür, dass Partnerschaften auf der Plattform für beide Seiten wirklich funktionieren.

Bühne & Pitches
Du bist eines der Gesichter von Bonoboo: auf Startup-Bühnen, bei Pitches und im Gespräch mit Kund:innen, Partner:innen und Investor:innen. Du erzählst unsere Story mit Substanz, Überzeugung und Begeisterung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung in Strategy, Business Development oder Operations, idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu CSR, HR oder dem NGO-Sektor

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du treibst Dinge eigenständig voran und baust Prozesse und Strukturen auf, statt nur darüber zu reden.

  • Kommunikationstalent: Du begeisterst andere für Impact-Themen, auf der Bühne genauso überzeugend wie im 1:1 mit unseren NGO-Partner:innen.

  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung für das Ganze übernehmen und Bonoboo gemeinsam mit uns aufbauen und skalieren.

  • Leidenschaft für Impact: Du glaubst daran, dass Unternehmen und NGOs gemeinsam mehr bewegen können, wenn die Partnerschaft wirklich passt.

Deine ersten Monate

In den ersten drei bis sechs Monaten baust du unser NGO-Partnernetzwerk systematisch aus. Du setzt die Prozesse für Matching und Impact Reporting auf und stehst bei den ersten Pitches mit auf der Bühne. Gemeinsam mit Julia und Max legst du fest, wie Bonoboo im nächsten Jahr wachsen soll.

Das bieten wir

  1. Teil des Gründungsteams: Anteile, Mitsprache und Einfluss auf die Richtung des Unternehmens. Bonoboo wird auch dein Unternehmen.

  2. Flexibles Arbeiten: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitstag selbst und arbeitest dort, wo du am produktivsten bist. Für die wichtigen Momente treffen wir uns regelmäßig in Düsseldorf.

  3. Raum zum Wachsen: Austausch mit unseren Business Angels und Zugang zu unserem Netzwerk für deine persönliche und unternehmerische Entwicklung.

  4. Ein modernes Software-Produkt mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Impact

  5. Ein Team, das schnell entscheidet und mit Leidenschaft arbeitet

  6. Die Chance, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten und Corporate Philanthropy neu zu denken

Vergütung

3.000–6.000 € brutto im Monat, plus Unternehmensanteile. Die konkrete Beteiligung legen wir gemeinsam im Kennenlernprozess fest.

So lernen wir uns kennen

  1. Erstes Gespräch: lockeres Kennenlernen. Wer bist du, wer sind wir, passt das grundsätzlich?

  2. Zweites Gespräch: Wir steigen tiefer ein, in Impact, Strategie und deine fachliche Perspektive auf Bonoboo.

  3. Drittes Treffen, gerne persönlich in Düsseldorf: Wir lernen uns auf persönlicher Ebene kennen und sprechen über Anteile und die Rahmenbedingungen.

Klingt nach dir? Dann melde dich bei uns. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

Bonus points: publications in simulation, graphics, or robotics venues (SIGGRAPH, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS). Contributions to an open-source physics engine.

title: CFD Workflow Automation Intern
description:
About Pangea Propulsion: We are a company dedicated to developing advanced propulsion systems for the space industry based on three key principles: high efficiency, sustainability, and reusability. We are revolutionizing the space industry with ground-breaking innovations that allow us to offer the best performance to cost propulsion systems.

Our goal is to be the propulsion provider for the next generation of spacecraft, which is essential to meet demands and compete in the booming space market of the next decade. We are a passionate, multicultural, and multidisciplinary team pushing the boundaries of what is possible in space propulsion technology. We have already made history by successfully testing the world's first 3D-printed Methalox Aerospike engine, marking a significant milestone for the space industry. We are looking for talented professionals to join our international teams in Barcelona and Toulouse.

We want to be a key player in improving diversity in the Aerospace sector as, in Pangea, we believe that diversity (gender, age, race, sexual orientation, beliefs, disability, culture, etc.) is a key to success. Within Pangea, everyone can grow with the same opportunities. We encourage you to apply. Individually we are different, but together we are an amazing team!

We are looking for a CFD Workflow Automation Intern for a 6-month internship in Toulouse.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled intern with a strong programming background and an interest in engineering simulation to help automate repetitive CFD activities across the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team.

The role will focus on developing robust, reusable workflows for meshing, simulation setup and launching, data extraction, post-processing, and standardized reporting, with particular emphasis on Cadence and Ansys Fluent environments. The internship is intended to reduce manual effort, improve repeatability, and shorten analysis turnaround time across the Fluidics Department.

The intern will work with engineers from both teams to identify high-value automation opportunities, translate existing engineering practices into scripts and workflows, and validate the resulting tools on representative analysis cases. Prior expertise in Cadence or Ansys Fluent is not required; strong programming ability and a willingness to learn the relevant engineering applications are more important.

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop scripts and utilities to automate CFD meshing, simulation setup, job launching, monitoring, and post-processing activities.

• Automate recurring workflows in Cadence and Ansys Fluent, using the scripting and interface capabilities available within those environments.

• Create reusable tools for data extraction, visualization, comparison, and standardized reporting of CFD results. • Work with the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team to streamline the design-analysis iteration loop, including comparison of CFD results with design intent.

• Work with the Fluidic Analysis Team to identify repetitive analysis tasks and convert them into reliable, maintainable automated processes.

• Define input requirements, verification checks, error handling, and user documentation so that the developed tools can be adopted by different engineers.

• Validate automated workflows against existing manual processes and document accuracy, repeatability, limitations, and expected time savings.

• Present progress and results to the participating teams and incorporate user feedback into successive tool improvements.

What you need to be successful:

• Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.

• Strong programming skills, preferably in Python; experience with additional scripting languages is an advantage.

• Understanding of software development fundamentals, including modular code, version control, testing, debugging, and documentation.

• Ability to analyse an existing manual workflow, identify repetitive steps, and translate the process into a structured automation solution.

• Interest in CFD, numerical simulation, engineering data processing, or scientific computing. Previous application-specific experience is not mandatory.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Soft Skills:

• Analytical and methodical approach to problem solving.

• Proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership of a defined work package.

• Clear communication and ability to gather requirements from engineers in different teams.

• Attention to detail, with a focus on reliability, traceability, and usability.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a multicultural, multidisciplinary environment.

Other useful skills:

• Experience with engineering or scientific Python and Matlab libraries for data processing and visualization.

• Familiarity with Linux, command-line tools, batch processing, high-performance computing, or job schedulers.

• Exposure to APIs, graphical user interfaces, dashboards, or automated report generation.

• Familiarity with Git or another version-control system.

• Previous exposure to Cadence, Ansys Fluent, CFD meshing, or simulation postprocessing is beneficial but not required.

• Basic knowledge of fluid dynamics or numerical methods is an advantage.

Supervision and collaboration:

The intern will be supervised by a designated engineer and will collaborate with representatives of both the Turbomachinery Fluidic Design Team and the Fluidic Analysis Team. The assignment will be managed as a shared departmental initiative, with priorities defined according to the automation needs and potential impact identified by the participating teams.

Not hitting every requirement? Research suggests that some people tend to hesitate when it comes to job applications if they don't meet all the desired qualifications. Here at Pangea Propulsion, we're committed to fostering a workplace that values diversity, inclusivity, and authenticity. So, if you're enthusiastic about this role but your prior experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification mentioned in the job description, we still strongly encourage you to apply. You might just be the ideal candidate for this position or other opportunities within our organization. Pangea Propulsion is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We consider all applications without discrimination on any legally protected grounds. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and we can provide reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process and in the workplace.

More about us…

We are an international and very multicultural team. Our work is guided by these core values:

Teamwork: We strive to work together as an aligned team towards our common goals.

Respect & tolerance: we value people with integrity that treat other people with respect. We enjoy having diverse views to enrich the debate and take better decisions. Passion for growth: we are passionate about space and about being pioneers; also, we value personal and organizational growth aiming to a constant improvement.

Sustainability: because a long-term vision and strategy is not possible if sustainability is not in the team’s core values. Daring: we do things that sometimes seem impossible, but we always go the extra mile to find a path to do them and we are ready to take the necessary risks to achieve our goals.

If this sounds good to you and you want to join the New Space revolution, we really want to meet you!

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
At Goodweek, we help businesses make the most of AI. Our platform brings leading AI models, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Mistral, together in one place, allowing employees to use the right AI tools for their tasks while keeping everything secure, controlled, and connected to the software they already use. By helping businesses manage AI more effectively, we enable them to save time, reduce costs, and improve productivity.

We work through our partners, including Distributors and Managed Service Providers (MSPs), who bring Goodweek’s platform to their own customers.

Our international team is based across France, Spain, and the United States, and our vision is backed by six international investment funds.

The role

As a Marketing Specialist, you will take ownership of our field marketing activities (trade shows and international events), paid acquisition campaigns (LinkedIn Ads and budget management), visual design and branding, and content localization across our target markets.

You will be part of a growing team where you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we present our brand and reach new audiences. We’re looking for a hands-on and versatile person who enjoys both developing ideas and putting them into practice. You should be comfortable moving between planning marketing initiatives and managing their day-to-day execution, from creating visuals to coordinating events and running campaigns.

Tasks

Trade Shows & Events

  • Plan and coordinate Goodweek’s participation in international trade shows and industry events.

  • Manage all event logistics and visual branding, including booth design, signage, branded merchandise, localized brochures, interactive activities, and contests.

  • Coordinate external vendors and suppliers to ensure smooth event execution.

  • Organise networking events, partner meetups, and cocktail receptions alongside major industry events.

  • Represent Goodweek on-site, engaging with prospects, partners, and industry professionals.

Localisation, Multilingual Adaptation & Content Rollout

  • Manage the localization and adaptation of marketing materials across Goodweek’s target markets.

  • Develop scalable processes to roll out localized content efficiently, using multilingual templates and automated asset creation where possible.

  • Ensure brand consistency and maintain high-quality standards across all translated and adapted content before publication.

Digital Acquisition & Budget Management

  • Develop and execute paid acquisition campaigns for each target market using LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

  • Manage the overall acquisition budget and continuously optimize cost per lead (CPL) and marketing-qualified lead (MQL) generation across regions.

  • Represent the partner marketing perspective in program design, working with Rev team, Operations, and Legal on how benefits, MDF, and tier criteria will work in practice.

  • Build joint marketing plan templates for reseller partners, including campaign calendars and success metrics.

  • Run Distributor-led acquisition campaigns using co-branded and localized kits for each market, and help Distributors customize them for their own MSP clients.

  • Own Partner Marketing Funds (MDF) end to end: coordinate with Revenue Sales team on MDF, help Distributors build proposals, track approvals and documentation, and connect every funded activity to registered pipeline.

  • Define KPIs, track campaign ROI, and prepare monthly performance reports and dashboards.

  • Create, optimise, and A/B test localized landing pages and conversion forms to improve campaign performance.

Marketing Automation & Workflow Optimisation

  • Create automated lead follow-ups, including multilingual emails within 48 hours after events.

  • Scale global communication workflows and develop modular email templates that can be adapted across markets.

  • Automate repetitive marketing tasks and improve the efficiency of campaign execution.

Brand, Design & Content Production

  • Create visual assets for the business, including advertising banners, infographics, print materials, and event signage.

  • Support organic LinkedIn growth by developing engaging post formats, carousels, key takeaways, and live event coverage.

  • Create and coordinate high-value marketing content, including customer case studies, blog articles, and lead-generation materials such as use cases and customer testimonials.

Requirements

  • Proficiency in English and either Spanish or French.

  • 3–5 years of experience in digital marketing or communications, ideally with initial experience in an international environment.

  • Advanced experience in design tools such as Canva.

  • Hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across multiple countries, particularly LinkedIn Ads, and working with marketing automation platforms.

  • Strong organizational skills and a structured approach to managing multilingual marketing assets across different markets.

  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment, adapt quickly, and reprioritize when needed.

  • Strong sense of ownership, initiative, and a hands-on approach to execution.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for meeting and engaging with international prospects and partners at trade shows and industry events.

Benefits

  • Health insurance provided by the employer

  • Meal vouchers and transportation cost reimbursement (50%)

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hybrid remote work

  • Daily use of English through close collaboration with teams in the US and Spain

title: Product Designer
description:
Software is not just vital but a strategic cornerstone of our operations. We’re looking for a Product Designer to set the cross-application UX direction for our commercial software - from pharma cold-chain visibility that helps temperature-sensitive medicines move safely around the world, to ULD tracking for airlines. You’ll define a consistent, high-quality experience across our modules and applications and support our specialised designers in bringing that experience to life, while remaining hands-on in discovery, from the first user conversation through to the final UX.

📍 Location: We are open to candidates based anywhere within the UK, Spain, and the Netherlands, with remote working available within these countries. Hybrid option available in the Netherlands.

Founded in Switzerland in 2012, SkyCell is transforming global pharmaceutical supply chains through a combination of advanced temperature-controlled containers, IoT connectivity, and digital solutions.

Our integrated product ecosystem helps leading pharmaceutical companies reduce risk, improve operational efficiency, and ensure the safe delivery of life-saving medicines worldwide.

Today, SkyCell operates at the intersection of hardware, software, data, and logistics - combining Swiss engineering excellence with a growing digital platform to shape the future of connected pharma supply chains.

Why SkyCell?

🌱 Purpose-Driven Work: Make a real difference by contributing to a more sustainable future in global logistics and healthcare.

🚀 Innovation at Heart: Work with cutting-edge technology and be at the forefront of supply chain innovation.

🌎 Stronger together: Join a supportive team of talented individuals from over 40 countries, where we work together every step of the way.

💡 Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in our people – continuous learning and development are key pillars of SkyCell.

🏆 Award-Winning Culture: Join a workplace recognized for its commitment to excellence with a ‘Great Place to work’ award, as well as a Platinum Ecovadis rating highlighting our sustainability and employee well-being.

What You'll Do:

A dedicated framework team owns our Design System and Design Guidelines, while embedded designers craft the screens and flows within each product module. Your role is to set the overall direction for the experience they design towards — including experience principles, end-to-end journeys and measurable outcomes that help multiple modules feel like one product.

You will:

  • Lead discovery end-to-end, including user research and interviews, journey mapping, jobs-to-be-done, pain points and opportunities, and translate research into a shared foundation for UX and product decisions

  • Create wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes hands-on using Figma and/or code to explore and test concepts during discovery, and run evaluative tests with users and engineers

  • Define the cross-application UX vision, design principles and success metrics together with Product and Marketing

  • Support and align our specialised designers - framework and embedded - around a consistent experience across modules and applications

  • Communicate UX principles and investment priorities to senior leadership, demonstrating the value and potential impact of UX-related roadmap items

  • Maintain the UX roadmap and prioritise pattern and design investments with the framework team

  • Produce high-level experience flows and service blueprints that connect journeys across applications and domains

  • Review Design System and module deliverables for alignment with experience strategy and brand

  • Support embedded designers from discovery through to delivery by co-framing problems, reviewing flows against the cross-application blueprint and ensuring continuity across user journeys

  • Set KPIs and use analytics, user research, A/B tests and competitive analysis to inform and refine design decisions

  • Promote a UX culture centred on user needs, inclusive design and accessibility standards such as WCAG across the organisation

  • Collaborate with Marketing on tone, terminology and brand consistency across products


What You'll Bring:

  • Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Experience as a senior or lead product designer working on complex B2B software, ideally within supply chain, logistics, aviation/air cargo or pharma

  • Strong experience leading discovery, from understanding user needs through research and prototyping to defining and refining UX solutions

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, with experience creating and iterating wireframes, mock-ups and prototypes

  • Experience bringing together multiple designers, including without formal reporting lines, to create a consistent experience across products or modules

  • Ability to communicate UX strategy, priorities and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders

  • Working knowledge of design systems and accessibility standards such as WCAG; experience partnering with design system teams is an advantage

  • Experience designing for multiple user groups, such as pharma quality/logistics teams and airline cargo operations, is beneficial

If you don’t meet every requirement but bring relevant experience and skills, we’d still like to hear from you.

What's In It For You?

⚡ Flexibility & Balance: Flexible working hours and work-life balance allow you to tailor work to fit your life.

🌟 Recognition & Growth: Opportunities for career advancement in a company that values your contributions.

🌍 Flexible ways of working: Our global teams work across our offices in Zurich, Zug, Hyderabad and Basel, with a mix of on-site, hybrid and remote working. Role-specific locations and working arrangements are detailed above.

🎉 Company-wide Events: Join us for company events to celebrate successes, build teams, and share our vision. Plus, new joiners experience SkyWeek, our immersive onboarding program.

👶 Generous Maternity & Paternity Leave: Support for new parents with competitive maternity and paternity leave.

🏖️ Annual Leave & Bank Holidays: Enjoy a generous annual leave package, plus local bank holidays to recharge and unwind.

Ready to Make an Impact?

We’re not just offering a job; we’re offering a chance to be part of something bigger. At SkyCell, you’ll help build a future where pharmaceutical delivery is efficient, sustainable, and transformative.

Stay Connected with SkyCell

Visit http://www.skycell.ch and explore #WeAreSkyCell on LinkedIn

How to Apply

Simply click ‘apply for this job’ below! We can’t wait to meet you and discuss how you can contribute to our mission! Please note, we are unable to consider applications sent to us via email.

If you have any questions, you can contact our Talent Team (

title: Junior Quantum Design Engineer
description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Junior Quantum Design Engineer, you will take on a vital, hands-on responsibility in creating our next-generation quantum processors. Your core focus will be centred on the layout, simulation, and verification of quantum processor components and superconducting circuits. Collaborating directly with other design engineers alongside cross-functional R&D teams spanning fabrication, measurement, and system integration, you will transform conceptual device architectures into production-ready designs while closing the feedback loop between theoretical design intent and empirical performance. Your work will be essential as we scale to increasingly complex systems and deliver on the promise of quantum computing.


What you'll be doing

  • Design and lay out superconducting circuit components and test structures, such as resonators, qubits, and control lines.

  • Perform electromagnetic and circuit simulations to predict device parameters and optimise designs.

  • Contribute to design verification, including design-rule checks and review of layouts against fabrication process constraints.

  • Compare simulation results with measurement data to validate design models and feed learnings back into future design iterations.

  • Help develop and maintain design tooling, automated layout scripts, and documentation to make our design flow faster and more robust.


Your Profile

  • MSc in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a concentration in Quantum Computing or Quantum Technology (PhD is a plus).

  • Understanding of microwave engineering, circuit theory, or superconducting devices, gained through coursework, a thesis project, or an internship.

  • Experience with EM simulation tools (e.g. HFSS, Q3D, Sonnet) and layout tools (e.g. KLayout, Qiskit Metal).

  • Python skills for design automation, simulation workflows, or data analysis.

  • Detail-oriented mindset with a structured approach to design, verification, and documentation.

  • Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow within a fast-moving, multidisciplinary team.

  • Familiarity with superconducting qubits, circuit quantisation, or cleanroom fabrication processes is a plus.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Reporter
description:
Compensation

This position requires a presence in Los Angeles

About the Job:

The Real Deal is looking for a reporter to join a rapidly growing media company focused on real estate journalism and headquartered in New York City. The reporter would be responsible for writing several original web stories per week and produce in-depth features for the website and our monthly magazine.

The ideal candidate will have an interest in covering money, power and personalities and a keen desire to learn how the industry intersects with politics, finance, law, entertainment and other areas of the business world. The ability to break news is a must, as is the ability to cultivate sources, pitch story ideas and write clean copy on deadline. Experience in business journalism is a plus.

Job Responsibilities:

Contribute three to six original articles per week to The Real Deal’s regular coverage of the real estate industry, typically focused on one of our markets (New York City, South Florida, Chicago, Texas, Los Angeles and San Francisco), but also occasionally on topics of national interest

In most months, contribute a longer story (1,000 to 2,000 words) to The Real Deal’s monthly, national print magazine

Occasionally contribute or collaborate on special reporting projects, typically investigative work or deeply researched features

Job Requirements:

Demonstrated writing, interviewing and reporting skills; ability to produce clean, well-organized and accurate copy on deadline, ranging from breaking news to long-form features and investigations

Ability to write with voice and authority

Capacity to develop expertise and a robust array of sources in one or more of TRD’s coverage areas, such as residential brokerage and home sales, commercial real estate (office, retail, industrial, development), politics and policy, and technology

Ability to obtain and analyze information from databases, property records, financial reports, social media and other sources to identify and enhance stories about the real estate industry

Understanding of and adherence to journalistic standards, ethics and protocol

Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple assignments

Team player; willingness to collaborate with colleagues; familiarity with newsroom culture

Business writing experience is preferred

Ability to do on-camera interviews, host TRD videos and moderate live events is a plus

Additional Information

Compensation & Benefits:

The salary offered within this range will depend upon qualifications and other operational considerations.

Who We Are:

The Real Deal is the largest real-estate news outlet in the US, reaching millions of professionals daily through our media channels. We have received 60+ awards for editorial excellence over the past six years, including the General Excellence award from the Society of Business Writers and Editors.

Quantcast rates us among the 300-most visited sites in the US and the website with the wealthiest audience and one of the most educated.

As a publication, The Real Deal is to real estate what Variety is to entertainment or what Politico is to Beltway politics – a plugged-in news outlet that is read by the entire industry.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We partner with our employees to support diversity and inclusion in the workplace and through higher education programs supporting rising journalists.

title: Digital Success Engineer
description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf

The Digital Success Engineer builds the automation, tooling, and integrations that power Jamf’s digital customer success motion — the agents, agentic workflows, and connected systems that deliver proactive, one-to-many engagement at scale. Reporting to the Director, Strategic Programs, the role partners with the Digital Success Strategy Manager, who owns the strategy and requirements for the motion, turning that vision into working, maintained technology that reaches customers and drives adoption.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Builds and maintains the automation, tooling, and integrations behind the digital customer success motion, including agentic workflows, in-app guidance, and the connectors that tie them to systems such as Snowflake, Salesforce, Gainsight, and Slack.
  • Turns the strategy and requirements set by the Digital Success Strategy Manager into working technology including scoping, building, testing, and shipping the components that deliver the engagement model.
  • Monitors, troubleshoots, and improves the digital-success tooling in production, including fixing issues, versioning changes, and keeping the motion running reliably.
  • Implements the logic that targets and personalizes engagement — translating adoption, health, and usage signals into the triggers and flows that drive proactive outreach.
  • Applies AI-assisted and modern development tooling — agent and prompt engineering, version control, and connector-based (MCP) workflows — evaluating outputs for accuracy before they reach customers.
  • Builds in the guardrails for automated customer-facing communication — draft-first review, human approval where needed, and controls that keep the motion safe to run at scale — consistent with the governance set for the motion.
  • Partners with the Customer Success Analytics Engineer and data teams on the data, definitions, and pipelines the tooling depends on.
  • Documents and packages what is built so it can be maintained, reused, and handed off.
  • Works with general autonomy on how to build, taking direction from the Digital Success Strategy Manager on what to build and in what priority, and escalating cross-functional or technical decisions as needed.
  • Evaluates emerging AI tools, models, and platforms, and recommends adoption where they meaningfully improve the reliability, speed, or reach of the digital customer success motion.
  • Other duties and special projects as assigned.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in a technical build role — software or automation engineering, solutions or integration engineering, analytics engineering, or similar — ideally in a SaaS or customer-facing context (required)
  • Hands-on ability to build and maintain automation and integrations — comfort with APIs, data connectors, and scripting or low-code automation across systems such as Snowflake, Salesforce, Gainsight, and Slack (required)
  • Experience building against defined requirements and priorities, turning a strategy or specification into working, tested technology (required)
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development — agent or prompt engineering, or connector-based (MCP) workflows — and evaluating AI-generated outputs with critical judgment (preferred)
  • Comfort with version control (e.g., git) and modern software and data-stack practices (required)
  • Working knowledge of customer success or customer-engagement data and metrics (preferred)
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work from direction and partner across strategy, data, and customer success teams (required)

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, quantitative, or related field, or equivalent experience (required)
  • A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered.
  • Certifications in relevant development, automation, or data platforms (preferred)

#LIRemote

How we help you reach your best potential:

  • Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News
  • Named a 2025 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Gen Z
  • Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024
  • Named a 2024 Newsweek America’s Greatest Workplaces for Parents & Families
  • Named a 2024 PEOPLE Companies That Care by PEOPLE® and Great Place To Work®
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world

Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.

What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Being naked is the #1 most sustainable option. We're #2.

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter and winning a Best Carbon Footprint award, we have big goals like being Climate Positive by 2025, Circular by 2030, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in Drapers and Sourcing Journal, and TIME wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own sustainable factory in LA. We innovate across categories like accessories, swimwear, and sleepwear, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this, this, and this.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide consistently magical customer service across all customer service channels
  • Deliver an excellent customer experience through a customer-first mindset to build long-term, loyal client relationships
  • Consistently meet and exceed performance goals
  • Be able to wear many hats (stylist, friend, personal assistant) when helping our customers shop for their next favorite item
  • Know our shipping, fulfillment, and returns procedures inside and out to help process all customer orders as efficiently as possible
  • Share customer and product feedback with internal teams such as Merchandising, Operations, and Product Development

  • Possess a high degree of empathy, judgment, patience, and level-headedness to communicate and apply our policies
  • Positive and willing to take on any task, big or small

  • Able to meet deadlines consistently while juggling multiple tasks; excellent with time management
  • Flexible and able to work in a constantly changing environment

Top-performing Seasonal employees may be asked to extend their contract and join us for the next season. They may also be considered for permanent roles on our core team, based on business needs and individual performance.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.
  • We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.

  • We’re a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you’ll get to collaborate with people all around the world.
  • You’ll get access to fertility care support through Carrot, and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.

title: Account Executive - Mid Market, West Coast
description:
About Thatch

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give every employee a real healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them, and employers get predictable costs they can control.

It’s a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology, and we’re just getting started. We look for people who like solving complex problems, use good judgment, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here care deeply about our customers, take real responsibility for what gets built, and are driven by doing work that matters.

About the role

We’re looking for a consultative, strategic Account Executive to join our Mid-Market sales team at Thatch, owning a market within our West territory. Alongside our Broker partners, you will work with HR, finance, and executive stakeholders at companies with 100+ employees to solve complex healthcare challenges. This is an ideal role for someone who can run an exceptional sales process, influence high-level decisions, and help us build a category-defining business.

Where this role is based

This role covers the West territory. You’ll own the market where you live. We’re prioritizing candidates who are based in, and well networked in, the market they’d cover. We’re hiring reps who live in, and already have broker relationships in the following markets: Los Angeles, San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Portland, Denver, Phoenix.

Please apply to only one territory job post (East, Central, West): the one that includes your market.

What you'll do

  • Lead high-stakes consultative sales processes with companies navigating complex benefits needs across your assigned territory.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive-level buyers in your market, uncovering deep needs and aligning them to Thatch’s solutions.
  • Work cross functionally with product teams to refine positioning for this segment.
  • Analyze and share insights on the competitive landscape in your market, influencing go-to-market strategy.
  • Drive forecasting accuracy and pipeline health for the regional territory through disciplined sales operations.
  • Build relationships with existing and new broker partners across your market.
  • Travel within your assigned territory to build relationships and support broker partners.

Background we're looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in group benefits mid-market consulting, specifically tier 1 or tier 2 brokerage firm background, healthcare carrier field representation, payroll sales, or HR tech / SaaS sales is a requirement.
  • An established network of brokers and benefits professionals in your market, and a clear plan for where you’d prospect first.
  • Strong working knowledge of group medical plans: you can read SBCs, analyze a group’s current benefits, and support quoting. You also understand the basics of underwriting, including plan design, contribution strategies, and key cost and risk drivers.
  • Skilled at leading discovery, building business cases, and influencing multiple stakeholders across finance, HR, and executive teams.

Experience we’d be particularly excited about

  • You’ve built a book of business from scratch and enjoy outbound prospecting.
  • Inquisitive and thoughtful — you know how to ask the right questions and listen deeply
  • Passionate about creating a healthcare system that people will love.
  • Comfortable managing long and potentially very quick sales cycles and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Someone who consistently embodies the Thatch brand and effectively represents our broker partners and clients.

What to expect

We interview rigorously based on integrity, talent, and drive; the trust we display in our teammates from day 1 is a reflection of the confidence we have in this process. We aim to evaluate the things you’ll be doing every day as best we can, and we move quickly. Here's what to expect:

  • 30 minute video meeting to talk through your background, your market, and your interest in Thatch
  • 30 minute video meeting with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your sales experience, your broker network, and how you’d build a book in your market
  • 30 minute video meeting to meet 2 members of our sales team to discuss your market knowledge, sales approach, and how you’d operate at Thatch
  • 30 minute working session with the hiring manager to go over a practical assessment focused on a real scenario you’d see in this role. We’ll share details ahead of time
  • 30 minute video meeting with the department head about the mid-market motion and your approach to building a territory
  • 30 minute video meeting with one of our founders to discuss your approach to culture and our operating principles

Please note: The posted compensation range reflects On-Target Earnings (OTE), not base salary.

Estimated Compensation Range
$200,000—$300,000 USD

  • Demonstrated success with large transactions and lengthy sales campaigns in a fast-paced, consultative and competitive market
  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • The ideal candidate has experience working with public sector Finance Departments.

title: GPU Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About PolarGrid

PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. A customer brings a model or a serving image. We run it on dedicated GPUs behind one endpoint, serve each request from the nearest site, and move traffic to the next nearest site when one fails.

Our goal is to make AI inference fast, reliable, and secure for customers running production workloads.

The Role

This role is responsible for scaling PolarGrid's inference network from a handful of sites to a geographically distributed fleet of GPU clusters. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will own how new sites and nodes come online, from provisioning and burn-in through validation and a staged move into production. They will define when a site is ready for customer traffic, and make sure each new site joins the network without hurting latency or reliability.

A core responsibility is running the global routing layer that sends each request to the best place to serve it. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will work with live signals such as network latency, capacity and health, and tune routing against real traffic to keep latency low and predictable.

The role also owns reliability across the network. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will set and track availability targets, build the health checks and automation that detect and route around failing hardware and models, keep recovery fast, and test failure handling regularly.

The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will build the observability, release and network systems needed to run a distributed GPU fleet without operations work growing with every new site. This includes end-to-end tracing and latency alerting, safe staged rollouts, network configuration as code, and security and DDoS protection at the edge.

Requirements

  • Experience operating distributed systems across multiple sites or regions with high availability targets
  • Strong networking fundamentals: BGP, DNS, TCP/TLS and load balancing
  • Hands-on experience running bare-metal GPU fleets: provisioning, burn-in, firmware and node lifecycle
  • InfiniBand or RDMA networking experience
  • Experience running LLM inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM, including multi-node serving, cold starts and TTFT
  • Deep observability skills focused on p95/p99 latency and gray failures, not just uptime
  • Experience designing failover, graceful degradation and automated recovery
  • Strong automation and infrastructure-as-code mindset, including CI/CD for infrastructure
  • Ability to plan capacity on constrained, uneven hardware supply
  • Experience building internal tooling or control planes, ideally in Go or Rust

Nice to Have

- DDoS mitigation experience

- Running DNS infrastructure at scale

  • Hardware security: TPM, measured boot or confidential computing
  • Real-time streaming inference, including voice and audio
  • Operating remote datacenter sites with on-site technicians
  • Certificate automation across many domains

- Deterministic simulation testing

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.
