description:
Job Title: Front-End Developer
Location: Fully Remote (US)
Department: Global Enrollment Marketing and Sales
Reports to: Director of Web Development
Classification: Regular, Full-time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

In unserem Angebot haben wir eine spannende, abwechslungsreiche Stelle als UI / UX Designer im everii Kosmos – mit der Möglichkeit, aktiv die Zukunft eines unserer Kern-Produkte mitzugestalten.

Als UI / UX Designer gestaltest du aktiv die Zukunft von TEAMBOX, unserer ERP-Lösung für Agenturen, Beratungen und projektbasierte Dienstleister.

Auf Basis von Feature-Konzepten entwirfst du ansprechende UI/UX Designs in Figma – und bringst dabei stets dein eigenes Feedback aus UI/UX Perspektive ein, statt Konzepte nur „blind“ umzusetzen.

Du bist im engen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, kennst ihre Anforderungen genau und entwickelst unsere Produkte kontinuierlich weiter.

Ein besonderes Highlight: Du begleitest und prägst das Re-Design von TEAMBOX und gestaltest den Look & Feel aktiv mit.

Das klingt nach dir? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Perfect Match!

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • UI / UX Designer: Du erstellst auf Basis der Konzepte unseres Produktmanagements Designs für TEAMBOX, unsere All-in-One-Lösung für Agenturen, Beratungen und IT-Dienstleister.
  • UX-Flows gestalten: Du denkst, kreierst und verbesserst UX-Flows und sorgst dafür, dass sich die Software für unsere Kunden intuitiv und stimmig anfühlt.
  • Designsprache weiterentwickeln: Du bringst unsere Designsprache auf das nächste Level.
  • Designumbau unseres Produkts: Aktuell arbeiten wir an einem größeren Designumbau. Du arbeitest hier im absoluten Herzen des Produkts.
  • Regelmäßiger Kundenkontakt: Du bist im ständigen Austausch mit unseren Kunden und Kundenteams, um ihre Anforderungen und Prozesse genau zu kennen.

Qualifikation

Deine Skills

  • Erfahrung im UI / UX Design: Du hast bereits im Design für Software-Produkte gearbeitet und kannst mit den gängigen Tools (wir nutzen z. B. Figma und Youtrack) umgehen.
  • AI-Tools im Workflow: Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deinem Design-Alltag, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen und Ideen schneller zu validieren.
  • Erfahrung im B2B Softwarebereich: Du hast dich bereits explizit mit B2B SaaS Software beschäftigt. Begriffe wie MRR, CAC, LTV sind für dich keine Fremdwörter.
  • Trendbewusstsein: Du bringst Drive mit und verfolgst die aktuellen Trends im Bereich Softwaredesign und Gestaltung.
  • Agentur-, oder Consultingumfeld: Idealerweise hast du Kenntnisse aus dem Agentur-, oder Consultingumfeld, die du im Produktdesign einbringen kannst.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse für den Austausch mit Kunden und mit unseren Teams.
  • Bonus-Skill: Hast du bereits Erfahrung mit TEAMBOX oder kennst du die Arbeitswelt von Agenturen und projektbasierten Dienstleistern? Dann ist das ein echtes Plus – aber kein Muss.

Benefits

Was wir bieten

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit echtem Spielraum: Top Equipment inklusive. Idealerweise bist du 2–3 Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office, aber wenn mal eine ganze Woche remote passt, ist das kein Problem.
  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team: Produkt und Entwicklung arbeiten direkt miteinander. Du bist vom ersten Tag an ein fester Bestandteil des Teams – nicht Zuarbeiter, sondern Mitgestalter.
  • Wachstum, das sich anfühlt: Kein Stillstand. Herausforderungen, die dich fordern, und regelmäßiges Feedback, das dich weiterbringt.
  • Kurze Wege, echte Mitsprache: Flache Hierarchien bedeuten bei uns nicht nur weniger Meetings, sondern auch: deine Perspektive zählt, nicht dein Titel.
  • Ein Team, das sich freut, dich kennenzulernen: Offene Kultur, ehrliche Kommunikation, keine Ellenbogen.
  • Wohlatmosphäre & Team-Kultur: Modernes Büro im Herzen von Hamburg mit frischem Obst, Kaffee, gekühlten Getränken und einem gemeinsamen wöchentlichen Frühstück.
  • Möglichkeit auf Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket & Lunch (über EDENRED/Sachbezug).

Lust, die Zukunft mitzugestalten?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem Lebenslauf, deinem Portfolio & deiner Gehaltsvorstellung – der Start ist ab sofort bzw. zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt möglich! 🚀

title: Werkstudent / Praktikant Content Marketing & Communications
description:
Über uns

toern ist ein wachsendes AI-Startup aus Hamburg, das den Retourenprozess im E-Commerce neu denkt. Mit unserer automatisierten All-in-One-Lösung helfen wir Shopify-Shops wie Saint Sass, NINETY-9 oder dem 1. FC Köln, Rückgaben effizienter zu managen, Prozesse zu vereinfachen und aus Retourendaten wertvolle Business-Insights zu gewinnen.

Wir wollen, dass E-Commerce-Brands toern überall finden, wo sie nach einer Retourenlösung suchen – bei Google, auf LinkedIn oder in ChatGPT. Dafür bauen wir unseren Content- und Marketingbereich weiter aus.

Du hast Lust, spannende Geschichten zu erzählen, kreative Inhalte zu entwickeln und Marketing aktiv mitzugestalten? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns Content und Kommunikation für die Ära der KI-Suche!

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest direkt mit Alena, unserer Gründerin, und Rike, unserer Marketing Managerin, zusammen. Dabei übernimmst du eigene Projekte und begleitest sie von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

Website & Content: Du schreibst und optimierst Landingpages, Blogartikel und Ratgeber rund um Retouren, Shopify und E-Commerce-Operations.

GEO & SEO: Du sorgst dafür, dass toern in KI-Suchen wie ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Overviews sichtbar wird. Dafür entwickelst du strukturierte Inhalte, FAQs und Vergleichsseiten, beobachtest unsere Sichtbarkeit und leitest Optimierungen ab.

Case Studies & Storytelling: Du führst Interviews mit unseren Kunden, arbeitest spannende Zahlen und Ergebnisse heraus und verwandelst sie in überzeugende Case Studies für Website, Sales und Social Media.

Social Media: Du entwickelst kreative Inhalte für LinkedIn und Instagram – von Posts und Karussells bis hin zu Video-Formaten.

Events & Teamkultur: Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und Organisation von Messen und Events, kümmerst dich um die Einladung und Kommunikation mit Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass vor Ort alles rundläuft. Außerdem planst und organisierst du interne Teamevents und bringst eigene Ideen für gemeinsame Aktivitäten ein.

AI im Marketing: Du nutzt AI-Tools aktiv für Recherche, Textentwürfe und Visuals und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue Workflows, um Content smarter und effizienter zu erstellen.

Dein Profil

  • Du studierst Marketing, Kommunikation, Journalismus, Medien, BWL oder etwas Vergleichbares (für das Praktikum ist ein Pflichtpraktikum erforderlich).
  • Du schreibst gerne und kannst komplexe Themen verständlich, kreativ und auf den Punkt bringen.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media und weißt, welche Inhalte auf LinkedIn und Instagram funktionieren.
  • Du interessierst dich für SEO und die Zukunft der Suche durch KI. Erste Erfahrungen mit GEO sind ein Plus.
  • Du bist kreativ und sicher im Umgang mit Tools wie Canva oder Figma. Erste Erfahrungen mit Video-Editing (z. B. CapCut) sind willkommen.
  • Du organisierst gerne, behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick und hast Lust, Events eigenständig mit vorzubereiten.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und hast eine Hands-on-Mentalität.
  • Du bist AI-affin und nutzt KI nicht nur als Tool, sondern denkst aktiv mit, wie sich Marketing und Content verbessern kann.
  • Du hast Interesse an E-Commerce, SaaS und der Startup-Welt.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Gründerin: kurze Entscheidungswege, direkter Austausch und Verantwortung ab Tag eins.
  • Eigene Projekte & Formate: Deine Ideen werden umgesetzt und deine Inhalte haben einen sichtbaren Impact auf Reichweite und Leads.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung in Content Marketing, GEO, SEO und B2B-Marketing in einem AI-Startup.
  • Einblicke hinter die Kulissen: Du lernst den Aufbau eines Startups kennen und arbeitest an echten Kund aus dem E-Commerce.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Wir finden ein Modell, das gut zu deinem Studium passt, inklusive Remote-Anteil.
  • Schönes Office: Unser Büro liegt in der Hamburger Speicherstadt inklusive Siebträgermaschine, Snacks und Team-Events.
  • Teamspirit: Wir arbeiten eng zusammen, feiern gemeinsame Erfolge und organisieren regelmäßig Aktivitäten als Team.
  • Urban Sports Club: Bleib auch neben der Arbeit aktiv.

Ready to toern things around?

Du hast Lust, Content zu gestalten, Events mitzuorganisieren und in einem ambitionierten Startup Verantwortung zu übernehmen?

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: SOC Analyst
description:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the Role

We are looking for a motivated Cyber Security Analyst to join our Security team and support the day-to-day protection of our systems, users and cloud environments.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone with existing cyber security experience who is looking to further develop their skills across Security Operations, incident response, vulnerability management and cloud security.

You will take ownership of routine security investigations, work closely with technical teams to resolve security issues and escalate more complex incidents to senior members of the Security team.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, triage and investigate security alerts and incidents across SIEM, EDR,CrowdStrike and other security platforms.

• Investigate suspicious endpoint, email, identity and cloud activity and support incident response activities.

• Analyse security logs and indicators of compromise to identify potential threats..

• Support vulnerability management, remediation tracking and security improvement activities.

• Maintain clear investigation records, security tickets, runbooks and operational documentation.

• Collaborate with Security, IT, Engineering and Cloud teams to investigate and resolve security issues.

What We’re Looking For

• 1-3 years of experience within Cyber Security, Security Operations, SOC or a similar technical security environment.

• Hands-on experience with cyber security technologies such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management or cloud security tools.

• Good understanding of security alert triage, incident investigation and common cyber threats.

• Understanding of networking fundamentals, Windows/Linux environments and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to clearly communicate and document investigation findings.

• Ability to independently manage routine security investigations while recognising when escalation is required.

Desirable Experience

• Experience with technologies such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, Google Chronicle, Microsoft Sentinel or Splunk.

• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and Indicators of Compromise (IoCs).

• Exposure to vulnerability management, cloud security or security automation/SOAR.

• Basic experience with KQL, PowerShell, Python or similar query/scripting technologies.

• Relevant cyber security certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+ or equivalent.

Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway’s success

  • 25 days holiday

  • Flexible working (2 days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore)

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

title: SAP Analytics Consultant
description:
We are seeking three experienced French-speaking SAP Analytics professionals to strengthen the internal SAP Finance/Analytics team of a public-sector client in Lausanne. The team supports the client’s financial reporting, budget planning, annual accounts and budget publication, all running on an SAP S/4HANA, BW / BW-IP, HANA and BusinessObjects landscape.

The three positions cover the full application lifecycle: one keeps the existing reporting and planning chains running, one builds enhancements and new developments, and one defines the target analytics architecture and guides the team through complex projects. All three work together within the same team, so you will have regular contact with colleagues across RUN, BUILD and architecture.

Location: Lausanne (minimum 3 days/week on-site during the first 3 months for onboarding and knowledge transfer, then remote. Remote work is possible only from Switzerland or the French border zone.

Contract: 01.01.2027 - 31.12.2029, renewable annually

Language: Fluent French

The Positions:

  1. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Corrective & Adaptive Maintenance (RUN) | approx. 100%

  • Qualify and analyse incidents on BW/IP, BO/Lumira, SLT, CDS/HANA Views and output management, including impact analysis

  • Reproduce issues and analyse data, performance, SLT replication and XML generation

  • Deliver corrections and changes across BW/IP, BO, Lumira, CDS/HANA, SLT and the custom ABAP XML program, with regression testing

  • Provide daily support for financial and budget reporting, as well as the production of annual accounts and budget publication

  • Deploy changes, support go-lives, carry out root cause analysis, and drive optimisation and documentation

2. SAP Analytics Techno-Functional Consultant – Enhancements & New Developments | approx. 60%

  • Analyse financial, budget and social reporting needs and map CRM/S4, BW, SLT and output management flows

  • Design BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira and SLT solutions and estimate effort and risks

  • Run POCs on analytical models, SLT and XML output flows

  • Build BW/IP models, CDS/HANA Views, BO/Lumira reports, SLT flows and the ABAP XML program, including testing

  • Prepare environments, transports and go-lives, and hand over to the support team

3. SAP Analytics Expert – Evolutive Maintenance & New Developments (mini-projects) | approx. 45%

  • Define the target analytics architecture (BW/IP, HANA, CDS, BO/Lumira, SLT) in line with the SAP roadmap and cloud analytics solutions

  • Lead scoping and GAP analysis, and deliver documented recommendations backed by SAP references and SWOT analysis

  • Lead POCs and validate performance and reporting output

  • Conduct design reviews, performance analysis and optimisation

  • Support the team on complex developments and knowledge transfer

Your Profile (all positions):

  • Senior-level SAP Analytics / BI experience on S/4HANA (for the Expert position: expert level, with proven experience in leading analytics architecture and design)

  • Strong BW / BW-IP skills in design, modelling, data loading, financial reporting and budget planning

  • Hands-on experience with financial reporting tools: AfO, BEx Analyzer, BEx Query Designer, WAD and broadcasting

  • Experience in budget planning, including planning models, simulations, consolidation and reporting

  • Solid knowledge of SAP BusinessObjects, Lumira and migration to WebI (N4V for WebI is a plus)

  • Experience with SAP SLT (CRM → S/4HANA replication, monitoring and troubleshooting)

  • Experience designing, extending and optimising CDS Views and HANA Views

  • ABAP skills to maintain and enhance a custom program generating XML for output management

  • Understanding of integration across CRM, S/4HANA, BW, HANA and reporting tools, with a focus on data quality, performance, security and governance

  • Knowledge of management accounting (controlling) and project management

  • Familiarity with RUN processes: incident resolution, SPS/SP cycles, regression testing, transports and Basis validation

  • Experience with Jira, ChaRM, Solution Manager and Confluence

  • Knowledge of SAP cloud analytics solutions (and, for the Expert position, the SAP analytics roadmap)

  • SAP Analytics certifications (BW, BW-IP, CDS Views, SLT, BO, Lumira, SAP cloud analytics) are an advantage

  • Fluent French is essential

What We Offer:

  • A long-term engagement through 2029, renewable annually

  • Meaningful work supporting the financial and budget processes of a public-sector organisation

  • A broad and modern SAP Analytics landscape covering BW/IP, HANA, CDS, SLT, BO/Lumira and cloud analytics

  • A choice of focus (RUN, BUILD or architecture) to suit your expertise and availability

  • Collaboration within an experienced internal SAP Finance / Analytics team

  • Remote working after the onboarding phase

  • Opportunities to shape the client’s analytics architecture and future roadmap

title: Talent Acquisition Intern
description:
Our Team

We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story.

 

With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity fuels curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another.

 

We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands.

 

Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel.

 

We’re looking for:

You’re someone with a real interest in people and an energetic team player with drive and a genuine eagerness to learn, especially when it comes to finding and welcoming new talent. You’ll join our People & Culture team and work closely with Talent Acquisition on real recruitment projects, so you gain practical experience from day one.

 

Our P&C team

Our P&C team drives engagement and performance. We focus on all elements of People and Culture, including Learning and Development, Recruitment, Employee Relations, Office Management and Employee Experience. Within the team, Talent Acquisition looks after everything from the first job post to a new colleague’s first day, and that’s where you’ll spend most of your time.

 

What you will be doing:

Working closely with Talent Acquisition, you’ll gain hands-on experience in:

  • Replying to candidates’ general questions by email, making sure everyone who gets in touch receives a kind, clear and timely answer.

  • Scheduling interviews in close collaboration with our hiring managers, so the process runs smoothly for candidates and interviewers alike.

  • Joining interviews alongside Talent Acquisition, so you can learn how great interviews work and build your own interviewing skills along the way.

  • Creating employer branding banners and visuals that show what it’s really like to work at Interrail.

  • Representing Interrail at recruitment events, such as job fairs and university career days, and helping to prepare and coordinate them.

  • Research recruitment initiatives and AI tools used at other companies, and share ideas we could try ourselves while building your own skills in this area.

  • Over time, taking ownership of hiring our future interns, from posting the role to welcoming them on board.

  • Supporting the wider P&C team with general HR tasks, such as onboarding or answering questions in the HR inbox.

 

Skills and mindset:

  • (Working towards) a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, or a related field, or otherwise eligible for an internship (for example, with an orientation year visa).

  • Previous (internship) experience in HR, recruitment or a related field is a plus, but not a must.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a warm and clear writing style, as you’ll often be a candidate’s first point of contact.

  • Curiosity about AI and digital tools, and a willingness to experiment.

  • Ability to work well in a dynamic environment.

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Fluent in English.

 

Our offer

  • A monthly internship allowance of €650 (Bachelor’s) or €750 (Master’s).

  • A travel allowance covering your commute to and from the office.

  • 2 days of paid leave per month.

  • We offer a flexible hybrid model that combines remote work with in-office days each week, promoting teamwork and connection.

  • 5 working days from abroad per 6 months internship.

  • A free global travel pass for you and a companion on completion of your internship, so you can explore Europe with your family or friends and share the same experiences as our customers.

  • Joining monthly borrels and other social events.

  • The opportunity to make a visible contribution, alongside gaining valuable experience for your future career.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly via our website Interrail Careers | Create An Impact.

  • Preferred start date 18 January.

  • We'll ask you to share your resume in English (our business language) and tell us why you're interested in Interrail and this particular role. It doesn't hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • As part of the process, we may also ask you to complete a short assessment to showcase your skills.

 

If we think you might be a good candidate, the next step is a relatively informal interview with some of your potential new team members. For you, this is a chance to understand if Interrail is your ideal workplace, and for us, it tells us more about the value you would bring.

 

In the meantime…

If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a feel for our culture, values, and place worldwide?

 

Got questions? Our People & Culture team would be happy to help - just drop us a note at 

 

While you're here, explore our travel passes and get inspired for your next journey at Interrail.com.

title: Mobile UI Designer
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Mobile UI Designer to create elegant, intuitive and high-performing mobile experiences for BJAK's AI Neobank and financial products.

This role is for someone who loves designing mobile interfaces that feel effortless, responsive and visually refined. You'll work alongside engineers and product managers to create experiences used daily by millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Design beautiful and intuitive interfaces for iOS and Android applications.

  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes and production-ready UI.

  • Design mobile experiences across insurance, payments, claims, investments and financial services.

  • Build and maintain mobile design systems and reusable components.

  • Work closely with developers to ensure pixel-perfect implementation.

  • Optimize interfaces for usability, accessibility and platform guidelines.

  • Iterate designs using analytics, usability findings and product feedback.

  • Ensure consistency across different devices, screen sizes and operating systems.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience designing mobile applications.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing high-quality mobile UI work.

  • Expert proficiency in Figma and interactive prototyping.

  • Deep understanding of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design.

  • Strong understanding of mobile usability, responsive layouts and interaction design.

  • Excellent attention to typography, spacing, colour and visual hierarchy.

  • Ability to simplify complex financial workflows into clean mobile experiences.

  • Portfolio is required.

Design Stack

  • Figma

  • FigJam

  • Design Systems

  • Auto Layout

  • Interactive Prototyping

  • iOS Human Interface Guidelines

  • Material Design

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks mobile-first.

  • Obsesses over visual polish and interaction quality.

  • Notices small UI inconsistencies before users do.

  • Cares about accessibility, responsiveness and performance.

  • Collaborates closely with engineers to deliver high-quality products.

  • Takes pride in shipping pixel-perfect interfaces.

This Role Is Not For

  • Designers whose experience is primarily marketing or branding.

  • People who design without considering real user behaviour.

  • Designers unfamiliar with mobile platform conventions.

  • Individuals who struggle to collaborate with engineers.

  • Candidates who cannot explain the rationale behind their design decisions.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Netherlands. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Netherlands.

 

Language

English is our primary working language across our global teams. Strong English communication skills are required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Portfolio review

  2. Practical design task (if applicable)

  3. Role-specific interview

  4. CEO / Final interview

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments promptly will be prioritized.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
We’re looking for a Marketing Intern to join the Contentoo team and help us turn good ideas into things people actually see.

This is a social and content-first role for someone who likes writing, design, internet culture, and making things. You might be a writer with a good visual eye, a designer who understands content, or somewhere in between.

You'll work with our Content Lead and Content Marketer, and you’ll help drive social media, campaigns, thought leadership, and podcasts. You'll start with hands-on execution and gain more ownership as you grow, all while collaborating with our wider team of specialists across events, SEO, design, video, and growth.

We're a small team, which means you won't spend six months doing one tiny corner of Marketing. You'll get to see how ideas go from “we should do something about this” to an actual campaign, post, page, podcast, or piece of content in the world.

 

About Contentoo

Contentoo helps global marketing teams scale content without turning their marketers into project managers.

We combine human expertise, technology, and managed content operations to take more of the production and coordination burden off marketing teams — so they can spend more time on the work that actually needs their judgement.

We're based in Amsterdam and work with ambitious marketing teams across Europe and beyond.

 

What you’ll be doing

A big part of the role is helping us get more mileage out of the ideas and content we already create.

You’ll help:

  • Publish and schedule social content

  • Engage with our community and keep an eye on conversations

  • Turn podcasts, reports, customer stories and existing content into new social formats

  • Create and adapt carousels, memes, quote cards, screenshots and other social assets

  • Support our employee advocacy and thought-leadership programmes

  • Help maintain our content and social calendars

  • Upload and format content on our website

  • Keep our content library, customer proof and marketing assets organised and up to date

  • Support campaigns with research, assets, distribution and reporting

  • Research competitors, trends and interesting things happening across marketing

  • Help with podcast, thought-leadership and event research

  • Spot good content worth giving a second (or third) life

You won't necessarily arrive knowing how to do all of this. That's the point!

 

Who we’re looking for

We're less interested in finding someone who already knows every marketing acronym and more interested in someone with taste, curiosity, and initiative.

You might be a good fit if:

  • You love writing or design — ideally with an interest in both

  • You understand what makes something interesting on social

  • You're curious about marketing, brands and internet culture

  • You notice good ideas, good copy and good creative

  • You're organised and care about the small details

  • You're comfortable learning new tools and figuring things out

  • You can take a clear brief and increasingly run with it

  • You have ideas of your own and aren't afraid to suggest them

  • You can start asap and are available 24- 40 h per week, being Tuesday to Thursday at our office in Amsterdam.

Figma skills are a big bonus.

Experience with CMSs, social scheduling, SEO, AI tools, or other marketing platforms is nice to have, but none of it is essential.

Video editing skills are also welcome, but this isn't a video-first role.

 

What you’ll learn

We want this to be an internship where you leave considerably better at marketing than when you arrived.

You'll get exposure to how a small Marketing team works across:

  • Social and content strategy

  • Brand and creative

  • Campaigns

  • Thought leadership

  • SEO and AI search

  • Customer and market research

  • Events and community

  • Product Marketing

  • B2B demand generation

  • Marketing performance and experimentation

You'll start by supporting the team with production and execution, but the goal is for you to take on more progressively.

Spot a meme opportunity? Make it.

Think there's a better hook? Tell us.

Find something interesting in the research? Bring it in.

Have an idea we haven't thought of? Even better.

 

What you'll get

  • A front-row seat to modern B2B marketing and the future of content

  • The chance to learn directly from experienced marketers in branding, ABM, and demand gen

  • The opportunity to experiment with leading AI tools and platforms

  • A €600 monthly internship compensation based on a full-time (40 h) internship. If you can't/don't want to work full-time, we are open to 24- 32 h per week too!

  • Free lunch at the office

  • Hybrid work environment (great office at the Houthavens + remote flexibility)

  • A bar in the office. Who doesn’t want a bar in their office?!

  • A fun, inclusive team — with rooftop drinks, Mario Kart battles, boat days, and more

 

Sounds interesting?

Let's have a virtual coffee to get to know each other! :)

title: Account Executive - Sales
description:
This position requires a presence in Los Angeles

This position offers a salary $85,000 - $110,000 plus commission

About the Job:

The Real Deal is looking for a Sales Account Executive to join a rapidly growing media company focused

on real estate journalism and headquartered in New York City. The ideal candidate will have a track

record of closing new business and at least 2-3 years selling advertising solutions with a consultative

approach. Typical deal size ranges from $10K - $100K/year.

Long-term we expect you to increase revenue generated from local and national Real Estate and

Endemic industry Advertisers, significantly grow our portfolio of local accounts, drive and oversee the

successful launch and execution of our premier Real Estate industry events and build sales of our online

advertising products.

What You'll Do:

Prospect, develop, and grow new business across multiple channels: digital, print, and live events

Build and manage a robust sales pipeline to meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual targets

Use CRM tools (HubSpot) to track activity, forecast revenue, and report on sales metrics

Collaborate with internal departments to ensure accurate ad delivery, trafficking, and billing

Develop strategic account plans in coordination with sales leadership

Represent the company at key industry events and build relationships with decision-makers and stakeholders

What You Bring:

3–5 years of advertising/media sales experience in a client-facing role is must

Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals

Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

Experience with sales CRMs, campaign reporting tools, and a good grasp of digital media metrics

Ability to multitask, stay organized, and work well under pressure

Familiarity with event sponsorship sales is a plus

Compensation

Additional Information

Who We Are:

The Real Deal is the largest real-estate news outlet in the US, reaching millions of professionals daily through our media channels. We have received 60+ awards for editorial excellence over the past six years, including the General Excellence award from the Society of Business Writers and Editors.

Quantcast rates us among the 300-most visited sites in the US and the website with the wealthiest audience and one of the most educated.

As a publication, The Real Deal is to real estate what Variety is to entertainment or what Politico is to Beltway politics – a plugged-in news outlet that is read by the entire industry.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We partner with our employees to support diversity and inclusion in the workplace and through higher education programs supporting rising journalists.

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.
Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.
Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.
As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.
Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.
  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.
Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.
Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.
Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH
Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.

title: Ingeniero de análisis virtual de rendimiento de vehículos y potencia fluida (Mod
description:
Sobre nosotros

Innovación. Sostenibilidad. Productividad. Así es como estamos abriendo nuevos caminos en nuestra misión de promover de manera sostenible la noble labor de los agricultores y constructores de todo el mundo. Con una población mundial en crecimiento y una mayor demanda de recursos, nuestros productos son fundamentales para alimentar y dar cobijo al mundo.

Desde el desarrollo de productos que funcionan con energías alternativas hasta tecnología de precisión que mejora la productividad, ofrecemos soluciones que benefician a las personas, y esto es posible gracias a personas como usted. Si le entusiasma la oportunidad de desarrollar sus habilidades como parte de un equipo global y colaborativo, está en el lugar correcto.

Haga crecer su carrera. ¡Construya un futuro!

Forme parte de esta empresa a la vanguardia de la agricultura y la construcción, que innova con pasión para impulsar la eficiencia y el éxito de los clientes. Y sabemos que la innovación no puede ocurrir sin colaboración. Por eso, todo lo que hacemos en CNH Industrial consiste en alcanzar nuevas metas como un solo equipo, cumpliendo siempre por el bien de nuestros clientes.

Objetivo del puesto

  • El candidato seleccionado apoyará el desarrollo de vehículos todoterreno de próxima generación, contribuyendo a las decisiones de ingeniería desde las fases iniciales de desarrollo de concepto hasta la validación final del producto.
  • El ingeniero de rendimiento de vehículos y potencia fluida es responsable de definir, evaluar y optimizar el rendimiento a nivel de vehículo mediante análisis de ingeniería, simulaciones virtuales, modelado de sistemas y actividades de correlación experimental, trabajando en sistemas de tren motriz, transmisión, hidráulicos, electrificados y de vehículo.
  • Se solicitará al candidato que realice simulaciones de concepto en fase temprana, lo que permitirá realizar estudios de compensación de arquitectura y evaluaciones virtuales de tecnologías emergentes antes de que el hardware esté disponible, dentro de proyectos multidisciplinarios complejos coordinados en organizaciones de ingeniería globales.
  • El candidato seleccionado contribuirá a la evaluación de soluciones innovadoras, incluidos sistemas avanzados de potencia fluida, trenes motrices híbridos, electrificación de vehículos y tecnologías de combustibles alternativos, apoyando la transición hacia máquinas todoterreno más sostenibles y eficientes.

Responsabilidades clave

Ingeniería de rendimiento de vehículos

  • Analizar y optimizar la productividad del vehículo, la eficiencia del combustible, la utilización de energía y el rendimiento general de la máquina.
  • Apoyar el establecimiento de objetivos del vehículo y la definición de requisitos.
  • Realizar análisis de flujo de potencia y balance energético a nivel de vehículo.
  • Evaluar la eficiencia de la transmisión, la capacidad de tracción y el rendimiento operativo.
  • Realizar evaluaciones comparativas competitivas y evaluaciones de tecnología.

Ingeniería de potencia fluida

  • Desarrollar y validar arquitecturas, subsistemas y componentes hidráulicos.
  • Analizar la eficiencia hidráulica y las pérdidas de potencia a nivel de componente, subsistema y vehículo.
  • Optimizar el rendimiento del sistema considerando estrategias de control, consumo de energía y perfiles de uso del cliente.
  • Apoyar la definición de soluciones innovadoras de potencia fluida para futuras plataformas de vehículos.

Hibridación, electrificación y combustibles alternativos

  • Apoyar estudios de viabilidad y actividades de integración de sistemas para arquitecturas de vehículos híbridos y electrificados.
  • Evaluar estrategias de gestión de energía entre subsistemas convencionales y electrificados.
  • Evaluar los flujos de energía, la utilización de la batería y la eficiencia general del sistema.
  • Analizar el impacto de los combustibles alternativos (HVO, biodiésel, GNL, GNC, hidrógeno y futuras soluciones bajas en carbono) en el rendimiento y la eficiencia del vehículo.
  • Apoyar las hojas de ruta tecnológicas y las actividades de selección de conceptos para el desarrollo sostenible de vehículos.

Desarrollo de conceptos en fase temprana e ingeniería virtual

  • Realizar simulaciones de concepto en fase temprana para respaldar las decisiones de arquitectura antes de la disponibilidad de prototipos.
  • Realizar análisis de compensación entre conceptos y tecnologías en competencia.
  • Desarrollar metodologías de evaluación virtual para el rendimiento del vehículo, economía de combustible, productividad y eficiencia hidráulica.
  • Apoyar iniciativas de ingeniería "shift-left" a través de enfoques de desarrollo basados en modelos.
  • Generar recomendaciones basadas en datos para acelerar el desarrollo y reducir el riesgo del programa.

Simulación y modelado de sistemas

  • Desarrollar y mantener modelos de simulación de alta fidelidad y de orden reducido.
  • Ejecutar actividades de validación virtual a nivel de componente, subsistema y vehículo completo.
  • Correlacionar los resultados de la simulación con las mediciones experimentales.
  • Apoyar los procesos de ingeniería basados en modelos a lo largo del ciclo de desarrollo del producto.
  • Utilizar entornos de simulación como AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink y otras herramientas de análisis de ingeniería.

Liderazgo de proyectos y gestión de partes interesadas

  • Liderar flujos de trabajo técnicos dentro de proyectos multidisciplinarios complejos.
  • Coordinar actividades entre equipos de ingeniería globales y múltiples partes interesadas.
  • Impulsar la alineación técnica y los procesos de toma de decisiones.
  • Presentar resultados de simulación, recomendaciones técnicas y actualizaciones de proyectos a la dirección y al liderazgo de ingeniería.
  • Apoyar la planificación de proyectos, la identificación de riesgos y las actividades de mitigación.
  • Interactuar con proveedores, socios de investigación y organizaciones de ingeniería externas cuando sea necesario.

Experiencia requerida

HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS (HARD SKILLS)

  • Máster en ingeniería mecánica, automotriz, energética o aeroespacial, o equivalente.
  • Experiencia profesional en la industria todoterreno, agrícola, de construcción, automotriz o de vehículos comerciales - años de experiencia: 3-5
  • Conocimiento de los principios de rendimiento del vehículo, tren motriz, transmisión y gestión de energía.
  • Conocimiento de sistemas de potencia fluida: arquitecturas hidráulicas, subsistemas, componentes, eficiencia y pérdidas de potencia.
  • Conocimiento de arquitecturas de vehículos todoterreno híbridos y electrificados, gestión de energía del vehículo y tecnologías de combustibles alternativos (HVO, biodiésel, GNL, GNC, hidrógeno).
  • Conocimiento de entornos de simulación como AMESim, MATLAB/Simulink y otras herramientas de análisis de ingeniería.
  • Enfoque de ingeniería de sistemas; la exposición a la ingeniería de sistemas basada en modelos (MBSE) sería una ventaja.
  • Técnicas avanzadas de optimización y diseño de experimentos (DoE), análisis de datos y herramientas de visualización.
  • Ingeniería digital y metodologías de validación virtual; aplicaciones de inteligencia artificial para flujos de trabajo de ingeniería (preferido).

HABILIDADES INTERPERSONALES (SOFT SKILLS)

  • Sólida mentalidad de ingeniería de sistemas y excelentes habilidades analíticas.
  • Capacidad para traducir información técnica compleja en recomendaciones prácticas que impulsen las decisiones comerciales y de producto.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación, con la capacidad de presentar resultados de simulación y recomendaciones técnicas a la dirección y al liderazgo de ingeniería.
  • Capacidad para coordinar actividades entre equipos de ingeniería globales y múltiples partes interesadas (ingeniería de producto, controles, validación, fabricación, gestión de programas, proveedores y socios técnicos).
  • Capacidad para trabajar tanto de forma autónoma como parte de un equipo multidisciplinario global.
  • Compromiso con los plazos, hitos y cronogramas establecidos.
  • Disponibilidad para viajes nacionales e internacionales.

Cualificaciones preferidas

  • Dispuesto y preparado para asumir la responsabilidad y la rendición de cuentas en sus propias acciones y decisiones.
  • Esforzarse por lograr la autonomía.
  • Comunicación abierta y transparente
  • Brindar un apoyo incondicional y superar las expectativas
  • Orientado a objetivos y soluciones (y no a obstáculos).

Transparencia salarial

El salario anual para este puesto es de 39.000,00 € - 52.000,00 € EUR más cualquier bonificación aplicable (los salarios reales variarán y se basarán en diversos factores, como las habilidades, la experiencia y la cualificación para el puesto).

Para los puestos abiertos en múltiples ubicaciones, el rango salarial indicado se refiere a la ubicación principal. Si se considera una ubicación diferente, el rango salarial aplicable se comunicará a los candidatos antes de la primera entrevista.

Lo que ofrecemos

Ofrecemos oportunidades profesionales dinámicas en un entorno internacional. Como empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades, estamos comprometidos a generar valor para todos nuestros empleados y fomentar una cultura de respeto.

En CNH, entendemos que las mejores soluciones provienen de las diversas experiencias y habilidades de nuestra gente. Aquí, usted tendrá la capacidad de desarrollar su carrera, seguir su pasión y ayudar a construir un futuro mejor. Para apoyar a nuestros empleados, ofrecemos beneficios integrales regionales, que incluyen:

  • Acuerdos de trabajo flexible
  • Beneficios de ahorro y jubilación
  • Reembolso de matrícula
  • Permiso parental
  • Asistencia para la adopción
  • Apoyo a la fertilidad y la planificación familiar
  • Programas de asistencia al empleado
  • Igualación de contribuciones benéficas y tiempo libre para voluntariado

title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert
description:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
